label: Dream-RSI: measured effects (from logs) and projections
built: 2026-11-15 by the benchmark lead; logs only: no training, no evaluation, no flight
rules: Measured values come from the gate logs. Projected values are labelled per row: tier A 'Projected — not measured' (from the model's own Dream-RSI log) or tier B 'Scenario — assumption, not measured, not a projection from this model's data'. Never mix them with measured benchmark values.

planner.loop: Planner Dream-RSI (imagine -> pick most-uncertain cells -> simulate -> warm-start retrain -> accept only if validation Brier on Site11 improves)
planner.gate_metric: validation Brier (Site11, 3 worlds), lower is better

series.skipped: no safe landing cells in this world

planner.note: The benchmarked planner_set.pt (saved 23:52 IST) is the generation-5 accepted model; planner_set_prev.pt (23:42) is the pre-Dream model. The pre-Dream model was never scored on Site23, so the Dream effect on the test benchmark is NOT measured (it could be, in seconds, by scoring planner_set_prev.pt on the stored labels; not done under the no-evaluation rule).

lander.loop: Lander pilot targeted Dream-RSI + solve-then-learn authority rules
lander.gate_metric: Site11, 1,024 paired missions: accept only with 0 regressions vs current pilot and classic and strictly more landings

series.candidate: pilot, classic flies after an engine failure, hand over below 5-15 m
pilot, hand over to classic below 5-15 m

net_effect.note: production pilot unchanged (same sha256 at every step)

rover_addendum1.loop: Key-free Dream-RSI-style loop on the failed rover v2 driver (online, on the site itself)

rover_addendum1.note: Online on the site being driven, not held-out. Returned stayed 0.0% in all 38 rounds.

rover_v3.loop: Rover v3 gated self-learning (map, solar belief, energy margin, charge thresholds)

by_change.dusty panels: 2 of 6 improved (DM1 NO CHANGE by label)

rover_v31.loop: Rover v3.1 gated self-learning (+ time-shifted light forecast, battery capacity, rejected-proposal memory, strict-rule gate)

completion_run_early_light.note: LM4 round 1 reached the gate: strict lost 87 -> 81 but gain 4.25 < 5.47 needed; run after the numbers had been seen

rover_v31.brain_upgrade_v3_to_v31_note: v3.1 vs v3 strict lost -7.1 pts [-13.8, -3.5] on LM2-LM5 is a hand-designed brain change informed by v3's self-learning diagnosis, not a Dream-RSI acceptance.

relative_gain_per_accepted_round.definition: fractional reduction of the loop's own error (1 - success score, or Brier) in one accepted round

pooled_evidence.caveat: 17 of the 18 accepted rover rounds repaired a planted fault (blocked route, dusty panels, shifted light); in unchanged rover worlds 0 of 32 rounds were accepted. The pooled gain is therefore optimistic for an unstressed benchmark.
